description: Mozambique - Electricity Transmission Network is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Transmission and distribution", published or maintained by Christopher Arderne (World Bank Group). Combination of the following data sources: 1) data collected and prepared for a project of the World Bank Group in May 2015 2) The Africa Infrastructure Country Diagnostic (AICD) study 3) OSM data © OpenStreetMap contributors This data is partially based on a digitized PDF map, and so is intended as a schematic of rough ... Coverage: Mozambique. It has 2 files in GeoJSON, SHP ZIP. The portal files it under Transmission and distribution. The portal gives 2017 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
